name: shenzhou the crew / descent module alone (entry)
note: Crew spacecraft render model (tools/make_crew_models.py), the crew / descent module alone (entry). Shenzhou in orbit: orbital module forward (docking), descent module, service module and its two pairs of wings. Body frame: +Z out of the docking port, origin at the port's contact point.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: the sim hands in a full attitude (approach, docked, entry); this law is only its fallback
diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes estimated from photographs
sources.source: Wikipedia 'Shenzhou (spacecraft)': service module 2.8 m x 2.9 m, descent module 2.5 m across, orbital module 2.25 m x 2.8 m with the docking mechanism forward, two pairs of service-module solar wings (~17 m tip to tip); one main parachute (1200 m2)
